f1.quote: Epitaxially deposited ten quinary IGM-PGM high-entropy-alloy shells, each containing Fe, Co, and Ni plus two platinum-group metals, onto Pd nanocubes.

f2.quote: HER was tested in acidic 0.5 M H2SO4, including measurements at −0.1 V versus RHE and durability over 15,000 cycles.

f3.quote: HOR was tested in H2-saturated 0.1 M KOH, including measurements at 0.1 V versus RHE and durability over 3000 cycles.

f4.quote: the resulting as-synthesized PtRuFeCoNi shell was an approximately equiatomic, randomly mixed, metastable FCC solid solution about 1.0 nm (approximately five atomic layers) thick.

f8.quote: it remains disordered through 200°C, locally orders at 300–400°C, and phase-separates at 500°C.

f9.quote: Relative to the other nine IGM-PGM-HEAs and commercial Pt/C, the approximately equiatomic PtRuFeCoNi {100} atomic layers should exhibit higher intrinsic HER and HOR activity
